zh.name: 每个阶段的数字与感受
zh.summary: 在每个阶段复用时间、数字、做法或感受字段，让一条变化轨迹逐页累积。
zh.useWhen: 每节点同时交代状态和体验；区别于现有以总量及组成盘点一段时间。
zh.instructions: 真实阶段照片、时间、同口径指标和本人记录
zh.output: 一组保留本模板风格、叙事与钩子的 Instagram 图文。

en.name: Milestone and Feeling Log
en.summary: Create an Instagram story carousel using the milestone and feeling log structure. Preserve its visual hierarchy, sequence and opening payoff.
en.useWhen: Use when your content needs the milestone and feeling log format.
en.instructions: Provide your topic, audience, usable source material and confirmed facts.
en.output: An editable Instagram carousel with this template’s sequence and visual style.

goals: 每个阶段的数字与感受
imageCues: 全幅生活照，顶部黄色细序号与横线，阶段名大衬线72–92px，关键数值以手写/粗体48–60px
中下部“HOW I SPENT / HOW I FELT”两段撕纸注释，正文30–36px
照片留可识别人和环境
